integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity converts this to ordinary topological Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A base-Q one-parameter subgroup separates all degree-d monomial weights. Catalecticants exclude every fixed monomial except the listed quadratic or pure/tangent cases.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: arXiv:1010.3546 is Algebraic Geometry and lists MSC 14N05 first.
integrity.secant_basis: Ballico--Bernardi study the same Veronese secant varieties at low border rank; Raicu defines the same second secant and proves cubic flattening-minor equations.

scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the second Veronese secant only; higher secants are not covered.
The exact-stratum statement is about border rank, not exact symmetric rank.
The quadratic boundary is already the symmetric-determinantal rank-at-most-two case and is included to state the sharp transition.
The n=1 rational-normal-curve specialization is covered by later characteristic-class work; the uncovered claim is the uniform higher-dimensional theorem and phase break.
An unindexed characteristic-class or transformation-group source may contain an equivalent Euler formula.
title: A quadratic phase break in Euler characteristic of rank-two Veronese secants
